title: 第18章 指导第19章 准备
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
凌啸风与张大山对凌宇和张浩刚刚的表现都非常满意，但他们也知道，这两个孩子还有很大的提升空间。
于是，他们开始指点起两人的不足之处。
凌啸风首先走到凌宇身边，轻声说：“宇儿，你的“陨星剑法”虽然犀利，灵活多变，但有时候过于注重招式的华丽，反而忽略了剑法的精髓。你要学会更加灵活地运用剑法，去掉那些不必要的动作，这样不仅能让你的攻击更加流畅，还能节省不少体力。”
凌宇若有所思地点点头，自己的父亲是一位经验丰富的武者，他的建议一定很有价值。
凌啸风接着补充：“你看，当你使出那招‘星河破碎’时，动作固然优美，但却露出了破绽，如果对手抓住这个机会，你就会陷入被动。”
说着，凌啸风亲自示范了一遍，他的剑法简洁而凌厉，每一剑都直取要害。
凌宇仔细观察着凌啸风的动作，深有感悟。
张大山也走到了张浩身边，他微笑着说：“浩儿啊，你的拳法和刀法都很有力量，但有时候过于刚猛，容易露出破绽。你要学会刚柔并济，以柔克刚，这样才能让你的招式更加完美。还有，你的法术释放速度可以再快一些，这样可以在战斗中取得更大的优势，而且你最大的缺点就是缺少一套步法，面对灵活的对手，你可能连人家的衣角都碰不到。”
张浩虚心地点点头，他知道父亲的话切中要害。
张大山继续讲解：“你看，当你使出那招‘狮跃山涧’时，虽然气势磅礴，但也容易让对手找到你的弱点，如果你能在拳法中加入一些变化，就会更加难以捉摸。”
接着，张大山展示了一套“狂狮拳法”，他的动作如行云流水，让人眼花缭乱。
张浩全神贯注地看着，他领悟到，拳法不仅要有力量，还要有变化和技巧。
在接下来的时间里，凌啸风和张大山分别对凌宇和张浩进行了更详细的指导。
他们手把手地纠正着两人的动作，分享着自己的经验和技巧。
凌宇在凌啸风的指导下，不断地练习着剑法。
他努力去掉那些不必要的动作，让剑法更加简洁明快。
每一剑的刺出都更加精准，力量也更集中。
张浩则在张大山的教导下，学会了如何在拳法中融入柔劲与灵活性。
他尝试着改变自己的发力方式，让拳法更加多变。
同时，他也学会了如何观察对手的动作，找到破绽并加以利用。

指导过程中，张大山和凌啸风不仅传授了技艺，还讲述了自己在战斗中的亲身经历，让凌宇和张浩更加深刻地理解了战斗的本质。
经过一段时间的刻苦训练，凌宇和张浩的武功都有了显着的提高。
他们的剑法和拳法更加精湛，配合也更加默契。
指点完两人后，张大山提议：“我觉得他们俩刚才的表现都很出色，是时候带他们去历练一下了，这样可以让他们更好地了解实战，提升他们的能力。”
这个提议得到了其他人的赞同。
张月儿在一旁听到了他们的对话，不甘示弱地说道：“我也要去！我也不输给他们，我也想去锻炼一下自己。”
凌啸风看着张月儿坚定的眼神，想了想，微笑着回应：“也好，那我们就组织一次全村年轻一辈的外出历练任务，让他们见见血，让年轻人体验一下现实的残酷。”
“是个好主意！”张大山随即应和。
content_en:
Ling Xiaofeng and Zhang Dashan were very satisfied with the performance of Ling Yu and Zhang Hao just now, but they also knew that these two children still had a lot of room for improvement.
So, they began to point out the shortcomings of the two people.
Ling Xiaofeng first walked to Ling Yu and said softly: "Yu'er, although your "Meteor Sword Technique" is sharp and flexible, sometimes you focus too much on the gorgeousness of the moves and ignore the essence of the sword technique. You need to learn to use the sword technique more flexibly and remove unnecessary movements. This will not only make your attacks smoother, but also save a lot of energy."
Ling Yu nodded thoughtfully. His father was an experienced warrior, and his advice must be valuable.
Ling Xiaofeng then added: "Look, when you use the 'Galaxy Shattering' move, although the movement is graceful, it exposes flaws. If your opponent seizes this opportunity, you will become passive."
With that said, Ling Xiaofeng demonstrated it himself. His swordsmanship was simple and sharp, and every sword hit the vital point.
Ling Yu carefully observed Ling Xiaofeng's movements and felt deeply.
Zhang Dashan also walked to Zhang Hao's side. He smiled and said: "Hao'er, your boxing and sword skills are very powerful, but sometimes they are too strong and can easily reveal flaws. You have to learn to combine hardness and softness, and use softness to overcome strength, so that your moves can be more perfect. Also, your spell release speed can be faster, so that you can gain a greater advantage in the battle, and your biggest shortcoming is that you lack a set of footwork. Facing a nimble opponent, you may not even be able to touch the corners of others' clothes."
Zhang Hao nodded humbly, knowing that his father's words hit the mark.
Zhang Dashan continued to explain: "You see, when you use that move of 'Lion Leaping over the Mountain Stream', although it is majestic, it is also easy for the opponent to find your weaknesses. If you can add some changes in the boxing technique, it will be more elusive."
Then, Zhang Dashan showed off a set of "Crazy Lion Fist". His movements were smooth and dazzling.
Zhang Hao watched with concentration, and he realized that boxing must not only have strength, but also have variety and skill.
In the following time, Ling Xiaofeng and Zhang Dashan provided more detailed guidance to Ling Yu and Zhang Hao respectively.
They corrected their movements step by step, sharing their experiences and skills.
Ling Yu continued to practice swordsmanship under the guidance of Ling Xiaofeng.
He worked hard to eliminate unnecessary movements and make his swordsmanship more concise and lively.
Each thrust of the sword is more precise and the power is more concentrated.
Zhang Hao, under the guidance of Zhang Dashan, learned how to incorporate softness and flexibility into boxing.
He tried to change the way he used force to make his boxing more versatile.
At the same time, he also learned how to observe his opponent's movements, find flaws and exploit them.
During the guidance process, Zhang Dashan and Ling Xiaofeng not only taught them skills, but also told their own personal experiences in combat, allowing Ling Yu and Zhang Hao to gain a deeper understanding of the nature of combat.
After a period of hard training, Ling Yu and Zhang Hao's martial arts have improved significantly.
Their swordsmanship and boxing skills are more exquisite, and their cooperation is more tacit.
After giving instructions to the two, Zhang Dashan suggested: "I think they both performed very well just now. It's time to take them to practice, so that they can better understand actual combat and improve their abilities."
This proposal was seconded by others.
Zhang Yue'er heard their conversation from the side and said not to be outdone: "I want to go too! I don't want to lose to them, I also want to train myself."
Ling Xiaofeng looked at Zhang Yue'er's firm eyes, thought for a moment, and responded with a smile: "Okay, then we will organize an outing training mission for the whole village's younger generation, let them see blood, and let the young people experience the cruelty of reality."
"That's a good idea!" Zhang Dashan immediately responded.
